title: GitHub - VelornLabs/velorn: AI-native video editing built around real creative timelines, generative workflows, and local agent control.
excerpt: AI-native video editing built around real creative timelines, generative workflows, and local agent control. - VelornLabs/velorn
content_html:
One prompt. The agent generates media, builds the timeline, and mixes the audio — live, via MCP.

Velorn is an open-source desktop video editor and AI video workstation. It brings planning, generation, asset management, timeline editing, captions, effects, and export into one project-based app.

Editing, captions, export, project management, and MCP editorial tools work without ComfyUI. All current generation features require a locally running ComfyUI instance.

Use built-in local and cloud workflows, bring your own ComfyUI API workflow JSON, or install the bundled Velorn Bridge so a graph open in ComfyUI can be sent back into Velorn.

What Velorn Is For

  • Creating music videos from lyrics, timing, characters, keyframes, video shots, and timeline edits.
  • Building UGC-style creator ads and small-business ads with editable shot plans.
  • Running curated local and cloud image/video workflows from one Generate workspace.
  • Running custom ComfyUI image, video, keyframe, and music-video workflows inside the app.
  • Editing generated clips with tracks, transitions, effects, captions, proxy/cache tools, and export.
  • Keeping generated media, prompts, workflow outputs, and timelines organized inside a project.

For generation, Velorn is not a replacement for ComfyUI. It is the production layer around ComfyUI: plan the work, send jobs to ComfyUI, collect the outputs, and finish the edit.

Download

Most users should download the packaged desktop app from the GitHub Releases page.

Release assets include:

  • Windows Installer
  • Windows Portable
  • Mac (Apple Silicon)
  • Mac (Intel)
  • Linux AppImage
  • Linux deb

Ignore GitHub's auto-generated source-code archives unless you plan to build Velorn from source.

Main Features

Generate

Generate runs built-in local workflows, cloud/partner workflows, and custom ComfyUI workflows.

  • Local image, video, image-edit, audio, and utility workflows.
  • Cloud workflows such as Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2, Seedance, Kling, and other partner-node routes where available.
  • Custom Image and Custom Video workflows for users who want Velorn to run their own ComfyUI API graphs.
  • API JSON import for advanced users who prefer exporting workflows manually from ComfyUI.
  • Velorn Bridge support so compatible graphs can be sent from ComfyUI back to the correct Velorn panel.
  • Workflow setup checks for missing nodes, models, credentials, and configuration.
  • A Featured / My Workflows / Templates browser with Local and Cloud filters. Imported community workflows appear in Featured next to the built-ins.

The Templates tab browses the official ComfyUI template catalog (500+ templates with size and popularity info) and launches any of them into the embedded ComfyUI tab.

Create

Create contains guided creator workflows built on Velorn's Director Mode engine.

  • Music Video Creation - turns a song, lyric timing, characters, references, and a director script into keyframes, video shots, and an editable timeline.
  • UGC Creator - builds creator-style social ads with hooks, dialogue, product demos, try-ons, testimonials, and editable shot-by-shot outputs.
  • Business Ad Creator - builds offer-first ads for local businesses, ecommerce products, events, services, and small teams.
  • Short Film Creation - experimental script-to-scene coverage workflow. This is still very beta and may have rough edges.

Music Video Creation

The Music Video Creator supports:

  • Song import and lyric timing.
  • ASR transcription or pasted-lyrics alignment into SRT.
  • People/cast setup, including existing character sheets.
  • Per-shot keyframe prompts, reference images, prompt copy, prompt editing, image replacement, and shot reruns.
  • Built-in keyframe routes such as Qwen Image Edit and Nano Banana 2.
  • Custom keyframe workflows using Velorn endpoint nodes.
  • Built-in video routes such as LTX 2.3 Music and WAN 2.2.
  • Custom video workflows with optional injected keyframe image, prompt, seed, width, height, FPS, duration, and audio.
  • Timeline assembly from generated shot assets.

Timeline Editor

The editor includes:

  • Project asset browser.
  • Multi-track video/audio timeline.
  • Clip trimming, moving, snapping, overlap replacement behavior, and transitions.
  • Text, shape, title, solid-color, adjustment-layer, keyframe, and visual effect tools.
  • Inspector controls.
  • Proxy/cache tools for smoother playback.
  • Export panel for final renders.

Captions

Captions can be generated from edited timeline audio and styled in-app.

  • Timeline-aware transcription.
  • Caption style presets.
  • Font, color, outline, background, shadow, and animation controls.
  • Saved caption style presets for reuse.
  • Live preview with play/scrub controls and safe-zone overlays.
  • Export-ready caption renders.

Export

The Export tab includes practical render presets, hardware-accelerated options where available, numbered PNG image sequence export, queue controls, and project-aware output settings.

Stock

The Stock tab uses Pexels so you can search and import photos or videos directly into the current project. A Pexels API key is optional and can be added in Settings.

ComfyUI Integration

Velorn talks to a local ComfyUI server and can also help launch it.

  • Default endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:8188
  • Custom port support in Settings.
  • Windows launcher support for a configured ComfyUI start script.
  • macOS launcher support for a configured ComfyUI.app.
  • Optional auto-start, stop-on-quit, and restart behavior.
  • Embedded ComfyUI tab for opening and editing graphs.
  • ComfyUI account login support inside the embedded ComfyUI tab.
  • ComfyUI credit balance display when available.

Only localhost/loopback ComfyUI endpoints are supported in the desktop app.

AI Agents (MCP)

Velorn includes a local MCP server with 100+ tools for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor-compatible tools, and other MCP clients.

  • Endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:19790/mcp
  • In-app setup: Settings > Agents (MCP) (one copy-paste command per client)
  • Guide: docs/MCP.md

Agents can inspect the open project, review timeline frames and visible shots, troubleshoot ComfyUI setup, preview safe timeline edits, queue approved generation work, and start delivery exports.

Agents can also bring in community ComfyUI workflows: hand one a workflow link or file, and it analyzes the graph, reports missing custom nodes and models, installs them after your approval, and runs the workflow on your timeline assets.

Most MCP write tools support a preview step, and many default to preview-first behavior. Normal timeline edits participate in Velorn's undo system. Imports, exports, generated files, project creation, and other filesystem changes are not universally undoable, so agents should get explicit approval before applying them. MCP is the recommended automation path for agent-assisted review, timeline operations, graphics polish, and generation workflows.

Custom Workflows

Custom workflows are one of the main reasons Velorn exists.

Advanced users can:

  1. Open a starter graph from Velorn.
  2. Modify it in ComfyUI.
  3. Keep the required Velorn endpoint nodes.
  4. Send it back with the Velorn Bridge or import the API workflow JSON manually.
  5. Run that graph from Velorn as part of a creator flow or from Generate.

Common Velorn endpoint node titles include:

  • Velorn input image - VELORN_INPUT_IMAGE
  • Velorn prompt - VELORN_PROMPT
  • Velorn seed - VELORN_SEED
  • Velorn width - VELORN_WIDTH
  • Velorn height - VELORN_HEIGHT
  • Velorn FPS - VELORN_FPS
  • Velorn duration - VELORN_DURATION
  • Velorn audio - VELORN_AUDIO
  • Velorn output image - VELORN_OUTPUT_IMAGE
  • Velorn output video - VELORN_OUTPUT_VIDEO

Exact VELORN_* titles are preferred, but Velorn also recognizes readable titles such as Velorn input image. Older graphs that still use COMFYSTUDIO_* marker titles are supported for backward compatibility.

If an endpoint is present, Velorn can inject that value. If an endpoint is not present, the graph controls that setting itself.

Requirements

Normal editing:

  • No ComfyUI installation or Comfy account is required.
  • Allow enough disk space for project assets, cache files, and exports.

Generation:

  • A separately installed local ComfyUI running on the same machine is required for all current generation workflows.
  • Local workflows may require compatible hardware, models, and custom nodes.
  • Partner-node workflows require the appropriate Comfy.org credentials and credits.

Optional integrations:

  • Pexels API key for the Stock tab.
  • LM Studio for the local LLM Assistant.

Local workflow requirements vary by model. Some workflows can run on modest GPUs, while heavy video workflows may need 24 GB+ VRAM. Cloud workflows shift most of that requirement to the provider but may require credits.

First Run

  1. Install and launch Velorn.
  2. Choose a projects folder.
  3. Create or open a project.
  4. Use Velorn > Getting Started from the bottom menu if you want the guided setup path.

To use generation, configure your local ComfyUI instance in Settings > ComfyUI Connection. This step is optional for editing, captions, export, project management, and MCP editorial tools. If ComfyUI is running on a non-default port, update the endpoint in Settings and run the connection test.

ComfyUI Setup Notes

Velorn ships workflow JSON files, but workflows still need the correct ComfyUI environment.

Depending on the workflow, users may need:

  • Custom nodes installed in ComfyUI.
  • Model files in the expected folders.
  • Cloud/partner credentials.
  • Enough local VRAM for the selected model and resolution.

Velorn 0.2.1+ talks to local ComfyUI without any CORS setup. On older Velorn versions, launch ComfyUI with --enable-cors-header if the embedded tab is blank or API calls return 403.

Inside Generate, use the workflow setup and dependency tools when something is missing.

Run From Source

For development, run the Electron app:

npm install
npm run electron:dev

Browser-only npm run dev is useful for frontend work, but Electron is the normal development path because many features depend on desktop APIs.

Build Commands

npm run build
npm run electron:build:win
npm run electron:build:mac
npm run electron:build:linux

Packaged artifacts are written to release/.

For release process details, see:

  • docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md
  • docs/CI_SECRETS.md
  • docs/AI_RELEASE_HANDOFF.md

Roadmap

See ROADMAP.md.

Contributing

Velorn is open source, and contributions are welcome.

See:

  • CONTRIBUTING.md
  • CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
  • SECURITY.md

License

Velorn is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. See LICENSE.

Versions released before this license change remain available under the license terms they were released with.

sentences.zh: 出口

sentences.zh: ComfyUI集成

blocks.html_en: Velorn talks to a local ComfyUI server and can also help launch it.

sentences.en: Velorn talks to a local ComfyUI server and can also help launch it.
sentences.zh: Velorn 与本地 ComfyUI 服务器通信，还可以帮助启动它。

sentences.en: Default endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:8188
Custom port support in Settings.
sentences.zh: 设置中的自定义端口支持。

blocks.html_en: • Windows launcher support for a configured ComfyUI start script.

sentences.en: Windows launcher support for a configured ComfyUI start script.
sentences.zh: Windows 启动器支持已配置的 ComfyUI 启动脚本。

sentences.en: macOS launcher support for a configured ComfyUI.app.
sentences.zh: macOS 启动器支持已配置的 ComfyUI.app。

sentences.en: Optional auto-start, stop-on-quit, and restart behavior.
sentences.zh: 可选的自动启动、退出时停止和重新启动行为。

sentences.en: Embedded ComfyUI tab for opening and editing graphs.
sentences.zh: 用于打开和编辑图形的嵌入式 ComfyUI 选项卡。

sentences.en: ComfyUI account login support inside the embedded ComfyUI tab.
sentences.zh: 嵌入式 ComfyUI 选项卡内支持 ComfyUI 帐户登录。

sentences.zh: ComfyUI 信用余额可用时显示。

sentences.zh: 桌面应用程序仅支持 localhost/loopback ComfyUI 端点。

sentences.en: AI Agents (MCP)
sentences.zh: 人工智能代理（MCP）

blocks.html_en: Velorn includes a local MCP server with 100+ tools for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor-compatible tools, and other MCP clients.

sentences.en: Velorn includes a local MCP server with 100+ tools for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor-compatible tools, and other MCP clients.
sentences.zh: Velorn 包括一个本地 MCP 服务器，其中包含 100 多个用于 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 兼容工具和其他 MCP 客户端的工具。

sentences.en: Endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:19790/mcp

blocks.html_en: • In-app setup: Settings > Agents (MCP) (one copy-paste command per client)

sentences.en: In-app setup: Settings > Agents (MCP) (one copy-paste command per client)
sentences.zh: 应用程序内设置：设置 > 代理 (MCP)（每个客户端一个复制粘贴命令）

sentences.en: Guide: docs/MCP.md
sentences.zh: 指南：docs/MCP.md

blocks.html_en: Agents can inspect the open project, review timeline frames and visible shots, troubleshoot ComfyUI setup, preview safe timeline edits, queue approved generation work, and start delivery exports.

sentences.en: Agents can inspect the open project, review timeline frames and visible shots, troubleshoot ComfyUI setup, preview safe timeline edits, queue approved generation work, and start delivery exports.
sentences.zh: 代理可以检查打开的项目、查看时间线框架和可见镜头、对 ComfyUI 设置进行故障排除、预览安全时间线编辑、对批准的生成工作进行排队以及开始交付导出。

blocks.html_en: Agents can also bring in community ComfyUI workflows: hand one a workflow link or file, and it analyzes the graph, reports missing custom nodes and models, installs them after your approval, and runs the workflow on your timeline assets.

sentences.en: Agents can also bring in community ComfyUI workflows: hand one a workflow link or file, and it analyzes the graph, reports missing custom nodes and models, installs them after your approval, and runs the workflow on your timeline assets.
sentences.zh: 代理还可以引入社区 ComfyUI 工作流程：向您提供工作流程链接或文件，它会分析图表、报告缺少的自定义节点和模型、在您批准后安装它们，并在您的时间线资产上运行工作流程。

blocks.html_en: Most MCP write tools support a preview step, and many default to preview-first behavior. Normal timeline edits participate in Velorn's undo system. Imports, exports, generated files, project creation, and other filesystem changes are not universally undoable, so agents should get explicit approval before applying them. MCP is the recommended automation path for agent-assisted review, timeline operations, graphics polish, and generation workflows.

sentences.en: Most MCP write tools support a preview step, and many default to preview-first behavior.
sentences.zh: 大多数 MCP 写入工具都支持预览步骤，并且许多工具默认为预览优先行为。

sentences.en: Normal timeline edits participate in Velorn's undo system.
sentences.zh: 正常时间线编辑参与 Velorn 的撤消系统。

sentences.en: Imports, exports, generated files, project creation, and other filesystem changes are not universally undoable, so agents should get explicit approval before applying them.
sentences.zh: 导入、导出、生成的文件、项目创建和其他文件系统更改并非普遍可撤消，因此代理在应用它们之前应获得明确的批准。

sentences.en: MCP is the recommended automation path for agent-assisted review, timeline operations, graphics polish, and generation workflows.
sentences.zh: MCP 是代理辅助审阅、时间线操作、图形抛光和生成工作流程的推荐自动化路径。

sentences.en: Custom Workflows
sentences.zh: 自定义工作流程

blocks.html_en: Custom workflows are one of the main reasons Velorn exists.

sentences.en: Custom workflows are one of the main reasons Velorn exists.
sentences.zh: 自定义工作流程是 Velorn 存在的主要原因之一。

sentences.en: Advanced users can:
sentences.zh: 高级用户可以：

sentences.en: Open a starter graph from Velorn.
sentences.zh: 打开 Velorn 的入门图。

sentences.en: Modify it in ComfyUI.
sentences.zh: 在ComfyUI中修改它。

sentences.en: Keep the required Velorn endpoint nodes.
sentences.zh: 保留所需的 Velorn 端点节点。

blocks.html_en: • Send it back with the Velorn Bridge or import the API workflow JSON manually.

sentences.en: Send it back with the Velorn Bridge or import the API workflow JSON manually.
sentences.zh: 使用 Velorn Bridge 将其发送回或手动导入 API 工作流程 JSON。

blocks.html_en: • Run that graph from Velorn as part of a creator flow or from Generate.

sentences.en: Run that graph from Velorn as part of a creator flow or from Generate.
sentences.zh: 作为创建者流程的一部分或从生成中从 Velorn 运行该图。

blocks.html_en: Common Velorn endpoint node titles include:

sentences.en: Common Velorn endpoint node titles include:
sentences.zh: 常见的 Velorn 端点节点标题包括：

sentences.en: Velorn input image - VELORN_INPUT_IMAGE
sentences.zh: Velorn 输入图像 - VELORN_INPUT_IMAGE

sentences.en: Velorn prompt - VELORN_PROMPT
sentences.zh: Velorn 提示符 - VELORN_PROMPT

sentences.en: Velorn seed - VELORN_SEED
sentences.zh: 丝绒种子 - VELORN_SEED

sentences.en: Velorn width - VELORN_WIDTH
sentences.zh: 丝绒宽度 - VELORN_WIDTH

sentences.en: Velorn height - VELORN_HEIGHT
sentences.zh: 丝绒高度 - VELORN_HEIGHT

sentences.en: Velorn FPS - VELORN_FPS
sentences.zh: 丝绒 FPS - VELORN_FPS

sentences.en: Velorn duration - VELORN_DURATION
sentences.zh: Velorn 持续时间 - VELORN_DURATION

sentences.en: Velorn audio - VELORN_AUDIO
sentences.zh: Velorn 音频 - VELORN_AUDIO

sentences.en: Velorn output image - VELORN_OUTPUT_IMAGE
sentences.zh: Velorn 输出图像 - VELORN_OUTPUT_IMAGE

sentences.en: Velorn output video - VELORN_OUTPUT_VIDEO
sentences.zh: Velorn 输出视频 - VELORN_OUTPUT_VIDEO

blocks.html_en: Exact VELORN_* titles are preferred, but Velorn also recognizes readable titles such as Velorn input image. Older graphs that still use COMFYSTUDIO_* marker titles are supported for backward compatibility.

sentences.en: Exact VELORN_* titles are preferred, but Velorn also recognizes readable titles such as Velorn input image.
sentences.zh: 首选精确的 VELORN_* 标题，但 Velorn 还可以识别可读标题，例如 Velorn 输入图像。

sentences.en: Older graphs that still use COMFYSTUDIO_* marker titles are supported for backward compatibility.
sentences.zh: 支持仍使用 COMFYSTUDIO_* 标记标题的旧图表以实现向后兼容性。

blocks.html_en: If an endpoint is present, Velorn can inject that value. If an endpoint is not present, the graph controls that setting itself.

sentences.en: If an endpoint is present, Velorn can inject that value.
sentences.zh: 如果存在端点，Velorn 可以注入该值。

sentences.en: If an endpoint is not present, the graph controls that setting itself.
sentences.zh: 如果端点不存在，则图形自行控制该设置。

sentences.en: Normal editing:
sentences.zh: 正常编辑：

sentences.zh: 无需安装 ComfyUI 或 Comfy 帐户。

sentences.zh: 一代：

sentences.zh: 本地工作流程可能需要兼容的硬件、模型和自定义节点。

sentences.en: Partner-node workflows require the appropriate Comfy.org credentials and credits.
sentences.zh: 合作伙伴节点工作流程需要适当的 Comfy.org 凭证和积分。

sentences.en: Optional integrations:
sentences.zh: 可选集成：

sentences.zh: 本地工作流程要求因型号而异。

sentences.zh: 某些工作流程可以在适度的 GPU 上运行，而繁重的视频工作流程可能需要 24 GB+ VRAM。

sentences.zh: 如果您需要引导式设置路径，请使用底部菜单中的 Velorn > 入门。

content_html_zh:
一提示。 代理生成媒体、构建时间线并通过 MCP 实时混合音频。

Velorn 是一款开源桌面视频编辑器和 AI 视频工作站。 它将规划、生成、资产管理、时间线编辑、字幕、效果和导出集成到一个基于项目的应用程序中。

编辑、字幕、导出、项目管理和 MCP 编辑工具无需 ComfyUI 即可工作。 所有当前一代功能都需要本地运行的 ComfyUI 实例。

使用内置的本地和云工作流程，带上您自己的 ComfyUI API 工作流程 JSON，或安装捆绑的 Velorn Bridge，以便可以将 ComfyUI 中打开的图形发送回 Velorn。

Velorn 的用途

  • 从歌词、时间、角色、关键帧、视频镜头和时间线编辑创建音乐视频。
  • 使用可编辑的拍摄计划构建 UGC 风格的创作者广告和小型企业广告。
  • 从一个生成工作区运行精选的本地和云图像/视频工作流程。
  • 在应用程序内运行自定义 ComfyUI 图像、视频、关键帧和音乐视频工作流程。
  • 使用轨道、过渡、效果、字幕、代理/缓存工具和导出编辑生成的剪辑。
  • 在项目内保持生成的媒体、提示、工作流程输出和时间线井井有条。

对于生成而言，Velorn 并不能替代 ComfyUI。 它是 ComfyUI 周围的生产层：规划工作、将作业发送到 ComfyUI、收集输出并完成编辑。

下载

大多数用户应该从 GitHub Releases 页面下载打包的桌面应用程序。

发布资产包括：

  • Windows安装程序
  • Windows 便携版
  • Mac（苹果芯片）
  • Mac（英特尔）
  • Linux 应用程序映像
  • 作为Linux

除非您打算从源代码构建 Velorn，否则请忽略 GitHub 自动生成的源代码存档。

主要特点

产生

生成运行内置本地工作流程、云/合作伙伴工作流程和自定义 ComfyUI 工作流程。

  • 本地图像、视频、图像编辑、音频和实用程序工作流程。
  • 云工作流程，例如 Nano Banana 2、GPT Image 2、Seedance、Kling 以及其他可用的合作伙伴节点路由。
  • 为希望 Velorn 运行自己的 ComfyUI API 图表的用户提供自定义图像和自定义视频工作流程。
  • API JSON 导入适合喜欢从 ComfyUI 手动导出工作流程的高级用户。
  • Velorn Bridge 支持，因此兼容的图表可以从 ComfyUI 发送回正确的 Velorn 面板。
  • 工作流设置检查是否缺少节点、模型、凭据和配置。
  • 带有本地和云过滤器的特色/我的工作流程/模板浏览器。 导入的社区工作流程显示在内置插件旁边的精选中。

“模板”选项卡可浏览官方 ComfyUI 模板目录（500 多个模板以及大小和流行度信息），并将其中任何模板启动到嵌入式 ComfyUI 选项卡中。

创造

Create 包含基于 Velorn 导演模式引擎构建的引导式创作者工作流程。

  • 音乐视频创作 - 将歌曲、歌词计时、角色、参考和导演脚本转换为关键帧、视频镜头和可编辑的时间线。
  • UGC Creator - 通过挂钩、对话、产品演示、试用、推荐和可编辑的逐镜头输出构建创作者风格的社交广告。
  • 商业广告创建者 - 为本地企业、电子商务产品、活动、服务和小型团队构建报价优先广告。
  • 短片创作 - 实验性的脚本到场景覆盖工作流程。 这仍然是一个非常测试的阶段，可能还有一些粗糙的地方。

音乐视频创作

音乐视频创建器支持：

  • 歌曲导入和歌词计时。
  • ASR 转录或粘贴歌词对齐到 SRT 中。
  • 人物/演员设置，包括现有的角色表。
  • 每镜头关键帧提示、参考图像、提示复制、提示编辑、图像替换和镜头重新运行。
  • 内置关键帧路线，例如 Qwen Image Edit 和 Nano Banana 2。
  • 使用 Velorn 端点节点的自定义关键帧工作流程。
  • 内置LTX 2.3 Music和WAN 2.2等视频路由。
  • 自定义视频工作流程，具有可选的注入关键帧图像、提示、种子、宽度、高度、FPS、持续时间和音频。
  • 从生成的镜头资源中组装时间线。

时间轴编辑器

编辑器包括：

  • 项目资产浏览器。
  • 多轨视频/音频时间线。
  • 剪辑修剪、移动、捕捉、重叠替换行为和过渡。
  • 文本、形状、标题、纯色、调整图层、关键帧和视觉效果工具。
  • 检查员控制。
  • 代理/缓存工具可实现更流畅的播放。
  • 导出最终渲染面板。

字幕

字幕可以从编辑的时间线音频生成并在应用程序内设置样式。

  • 时间线感知转录。
  • 字幕样式预设。
  • 字体、颜色、轮廓、背景、阴影和动画控件。
  • 保存的字幕样式预设以供重复使用。
  • 带有播放/滑动控件和安全区域覆盖的实时预览。
  • 可导出的字幕渲染。

出口

“导出”选项卡包括实用的渲染预设、可用的硬件加速选项、编号的 PNG 图像序列导出、队列控件和项目感知输出设置。

Stock

Stock 选项卡使用 Pexels，因此您可以搜索照片或视频并将其直接导入到当前项目中。 Pexels API 密钥是可选的，可以在“设置”中添加。

ComfyUI集成

Velorn 与本地 ComfyUI 服务器通信，还可以帮助启动它。

  • 默认端点：http://127.0.0.1:8188
  • 设置中的自定义端口支持。
  • Windows 启动器支持已配置的 ComfyUI 启动脚本。
  • macOS 启动器支持已配置的 ComfyUI.app。
  • 可选的自动启动、退出时停止和重新启动行为。
  • 用于打开和编辑图形的嵌入式 ComfyUI 选项卡。
  • 嵌入式 ComfyUI 选项卡内支持 ComfyUI 帐户登录。
  • ComfyUI 信用余额可用时显示。

桌面应用程序仅支持 localhost/loopback ComfyUI 端点。

人工智能代理（MCP）

Velorn 包括一个本地 MCP 服务器，其中包含 100 多个用于 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 兼容工具和其他 MCP 客户端的工具。

  • 端点：http://127.0.0.1:19790/mcp
  • 应用程序内设置：设置 > 代理 (MCP)（每个客户端一个复制粘贴命令）
  • 指南：docs/MCP.md

代理可以检查打开的项目、查看时间线框架和可见镜头、对 ComfyUI 设置进行故障排除、预览安全时间线编辑、对批准的生成工作进行排队以及开始交付导出。

代理还可以引入社区 ComfyUI 工作流程：向您提供工作流程链接或文件，它会分析图表、报告缺少的自定义节点和模型、在您批准后安装它们，并在您的时间线资产上运行工作流程。

大多数 MCP 写入工具都支持预览步骤，并且许多工具默认为预览优先行为。 正常时间线编辑参与 Velorn 的撤消系统。 导入、导出、生成的文件、项目创建和其他文件系统更改并非普遍可撤消，因此代理在应用它们之前应获得明确的批准。 MCP 是代理辅助审阅、时间线操作、图形抛光和生成工作流程的推荐自动化路径。

自定义工作流程

自定义工作流程是 Velorn 存在的主要原因之一。

高级用户可以：

  1. 打开 Velorn 的入门图。
  2. 在ComfyUI中修改它。
  3. 保留所需的 Velorn 端点节点。
  4. 使用 Velorn Bridge 将其发送回或手动导入 API 工作流程 JSON。
  5. 作为创建者流程的一部分或从生成中从 Velorn 运行该图。

常见的 Velorn 端点节点标题包括：

  • Velorn 输入图像 - VELORN_INPUT_IMAGE
  • Velorn 提示符 - VELORN_PROMPT
  • 丝绒种子 - VELORN_SEED
  • 丝绒宽度 - VELORN_WIDTH
  • 丝绒高度 - VELORN_HEIGHT
  • 丝绒 FPS - VELORN_FPS
  • Velorn 持续时间 - VELORN_DURATION
  • Velorn 音频 - VELORN_AUDIO
  • Velorn 输出图像 - VELORN_OUTPUT_IMAGE
  • Velorn 输出视频 - VELORN_OUTPUT_VIDEO

首选精确的 VELORN_* 标题，但 Velorn 还可以识别可读标题，例如 Velorn 输入图像。 支持仍使用 COMFYSTUDIO_* 标记标题的旧图表以实现向后兼容性。

如果存在端点，Velorn 可以注入该值。 如果端点不存在，则图形自行控制该设置。

要求

正常编辑：

  • 无需安装 ComfyUI 或 Comfy 帐户。
  • 为项目资源、缓存文件和导出留出足够的磁盘空间。

一代：

  • 所有当前一代工作流程都需要在同一台计算机上运行单独安装的本地 ComfyUI。
  • 本地工作流程可能需要兼容的硬件、模型和自定义节点。
  • 合作伙伴节点工作流程需要适当的 Comfy.org 凭证和积分。

可选集成：

  • “股票”选项卡的 Pexels API 密钥。
  • LM Studio 为本地 LLM 助理。

本地工作流程要求因型号而异。 某些工作流程可以在适度的 GPU 上运行，而繁重的视频工作流程可能需要 24 GB+ VRAM。 云工作流程将大部分要求转移给提供商，但可能需要积分。

第一次运行

  1. 安装并启动 Velorn。
  2. 选择一个项目文件夹。
  3. 创建或打开项目。
  4. 如果您需要引导式设置路径，请使用底部菜单中的 Velorn > 入门。

要使用生成，请在“设置”>“ComfyUI 连接”中配置本地 ComfyUI 实例。 对于编辑、字幕、导出、项目管理和 MCP 编辑工具，此步骤是可选的。 如果 ComfyUI 在非默认端口上运行，请在“设置”中更新端点并运行连接测试。

ComfyUI 设置说明

Velorn 提供工作流程 JSON 文件，但工作流程仍然需要正确的 ComfyUI 环境。

根据工作流程，用户可能需要：

  • ComfyUI 中安装的自定义节点。
  • 预期文件夹中的模型文件。
  • 云/合作伙伴凭据。
  • 足够的本地 VRAM 用于所选型号和分辨率。

Velorn 0.2.1+ 无需任何 CORS 设置即可与本地 ComfyUI 对话。 在较旧的 Velorn 版本上，如果嵌入式选项卡为空或 API 调用返回 403，请使用 --enable-cors-header 启动 ComfyUI。

在“生成”中，当缺少某些内容时，请使用工作流程设置和依赖项工具。

从源代码运行

对于开发，运行 Electron 应用程序：

npm install
npm run electron:dev

仅限浏览器的 npm run dev 对于前端工作很有用，但 Electron 是正常的开发路径，因为许多功能依赖于桌面 API。

构建命令

npm run build
npm run electron:build:win
npm run electron:build:mac
npm run electron:build:linux

打包的工件被写入release/。
